items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: He'd come down. We would hire him, and that's what he liked, when he could play all night long and jam.

ctx.x: He was a fellow that -- he didn't care for the limelight. Like we'd be playing a place after get through with our regular hours and John (unintelligible) with the job. He'd come down. We would hire him, and that's what he liked, when he could play all night long and jam.
So that's very unusual. Was he married?
